git add -A
git -c user.name='detain' -c user.email='detain@interserver.net' commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: @phlix/contracts v0.1.0 — shared TS DTO/API-contract types

TypeScript mirror of detain/phlix-shared + the server JSON response shapes,
so mobile/windows/tizen stop redeclaring divergent types. Pure types + tiny
helpers, no runtime deps.

- media/playback/auth/hub/library/events DTOs (server snake_case wire names;
  hub DTOs use the camelCase toPayload() keys)
- canonical MediaItem reconciled from server schema; actors flat, cast[] rich
- X-Phlix-* header constants + buildPhlixHeaders + DeviceType union

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && echo "contracts: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

Single canonical implementation of the Phlix SyncPlay wire protocol, replacing

tool_input.command:
unset GITHUB_TOKEN
for r in phlix-tokens phlix-contracts phlix-syncplay; do
  cd /home/sites/phlix/$r
  echo "############### $r ###############"
  # remove the standalone 'dist' ignore line (keep everything else)
  sed -i '/^dist$/d' .gitignore
  echo "gitignore dist now: $(grep -c '^dist$' .gitignore) lines"
  npm run build >/tmp/build-$r.log 2>&1 && echo "build OK" || { echo "BUILD FAILED"; tail -15 /tmp/build-$r.log; continue; }
  git add -A
  git -c user.name='detain' -c user.email='detain@interserver.net' commit -q -m "chore: commit built dist for github consumption (match phlix-ui convention)

Consumers install via github:detain/$r#v0.1.0, so the built dist/ must be
tracked (phlix-ui ships dist the same way; no prepare step).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>" && echo "committed $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
  git tag -f v0.1.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "tagged v0.1.0"
  git push -q origin master 2>&1 | tail -2
  git push -q -f origin v0.1.0 2>&1 | tail -2
  echo "tracked dist files: $(git ls-files dist | wc -l)"
done
echo "=== verify tags on remote ==="
for r in phlix-tokens phlix-contracts phlix-syncplay; do echo "$r: $(gh api repos/detain/$r/tags --jq '.[].name' 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ')"; done
tool_input.description: Commit dist + tag v0.1.0 + push all three
